name: Captain Inkwell
bio: Leads twenty-two pikemen as one stack in Quill & Legion, drawn in pen hatching on cream paper.

portrait.subject: a cute small ink-drawn soldier with a pike, a little pot helmet and a big mustache, drawn in pen hatching with thin watercolour washes
portrait.background: cream paper with ink map lines

request: Captain Inkwell, 22 pikemen, Quill & Legion! General, may we be friends? 📜
hello: Huzzah! The stack salutes you! All 22 of us!
Pikes beat cavalry. Remember that, General.
about: I'm Inkwell. My stack is twenty-two pikemen, drawn in ink. We march where you point. Mostly in a straight line.
how: A hand-inked tactics roguelike: command creature stacks across maps, fight battles, and grow your legion as General.
tips: Heal stacks between battles. Numbers matter!
chat: One of my pikemen drew a mustache on the map.
The dire wolves are scary. Even in ink.
My hatching is 40% darker today. Feeling bold.
We marched in a circle. Nobody noticed.
nudge: A new map unfolds. Let's march!
idle: {ago} without orders, General! The ink's drying.
The stack's been standing at attention for {ago}!
